program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 7)))
             (define r0 (first bb))
             (define c0 (second bb))
             (define r1 (third bb))
             (define c1 (fourth bb))
             (define gh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
             (define gw (+ 1 (- c1 c0)))
             (define hstep (+ gw 1))
             (define vstep (+ gh 1))
             (define (mask? local-r local-c)
               (= (safe-at g (+ r0 local-r) (+ c0 local-c) 0) 7))
             (define (paint? r c)
               (if (or (< r r0) (< c c0))
                   #f
                   (let* ((rr (- r r0))
                          (cc (- c c0))
                          (local-r (mod rr vstep))
                          (local-c (mod cc hstep))
                          (inst (quotient cc hstep))
                          (row-rep (quotient rr vstep)))
                     (and
                       (< local-r gh)
                       (< local-c gw)
                       (mask? local-r local-c)
                       (or (zero? row-rep) (= (mod inst 3) 2))))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (if (paint? r c)
                          (if (= (mod (quotient (- c c0) hstep) 3) 2) 6 7)
                          0))))))
